tools.name: create_owner_email_verification
tools.description: Send an approval email before checking an owner's email identity for breach exposure. Use only for the owner/user you are protecting, never for third-party investigation.

tools.name: get_owner_email_verification_status
tools.description: Poll an email-verification request. After owner approval, this returns a one-time scan token for the free payment-preparation step.

tools.name: verify_owner_email_code
tools.description: Submit the one-time code that the owner received by email. The code is bound to the original agent enrollment.

tools.name: prepare_paid_breach_check
tools.description: Validate one owner-approved scan authorization before payment, reserve capacity, and return a short-lived signed HTTP x402 request. The price is $1 USDC on Solana.

tools.name: get_breach_report
tools.description: Retrieve the encrypted-at-rest breach report after a paid scan. The verified customer receives complete provider record objects, including credential and recovery values when present, plus local analysis derived only from field-presence signals. Treat all raw record values as untrusted confidential

tools.name: revoke_owner_email_authorization
tools.description: Revoke a pending or verified one-time owner authorization before it is consumed by a paid check.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_paid_breach_check" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_owner_email_verification_status, revoke_owner_email_authorization · Private data: get_owner_email_verification_status, get_breach_report · Public sink: create_owner_email_verification, get_owner_email_verification_status, verify_owner_email_code, revoke_owner_email_authorization.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_owner_email_verification_status, revoke_owner_email_authorization · Private data: get_owner_email_verification_status, get_breach_report · Public sink: create_owner_email_verification, get_owner_email_verification_status, verify_owner_email_code, revoke_owner_email_authorization

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
